objective: Sincronizador | Ventas | 130MID | Septiembre 2026 | Encabezado + Detalle | Ejecutar sincronizacion comercial mensual completa del 01/09/2026 al 30/09/2026 usando COMERCIAL_RANGE_RESYNC y certificar encabezado y detalle.

queries.name: ventas_130mid_202609_paridad
queries.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT fecha_operacion,
         CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-09-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY fecha_operacion
), dt AS (
  SELECT fecha_operacion, numero_ticket,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) venta,
         MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-09-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-10-01'
    AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1
  GROUP BY fecha_operacion, numero_ticket
), d AS (
  SELECT fecha_operacion,
         CAST(SUM(venta) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas,
         COUNT_BIG(*) tickets,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM dt
  GROUP BY fecha_operacion
), x AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(r.fecha_operacion,d.fecha_operacion) fecha,
         ISNULL(r.ventas,0) ventas_header, ISNULL(d.ventas,0) ventas_detail,
         ISNULL(r.tickets,0) tickets_header, ISNULL(d.tickets,0) tickets_detail,
         ISNULL(r.pax,0) pax_header, ISNULL(d.pax,0) pax_detail
  FROM r
  FULL OUTER JOIN d ON d.fecha_operacion=r.fecha_operacion
)
SELECT COUNT(*) dias_evaluados,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(ventas_header-ventas_detail)<=0.05
                 AND tickets_header=tickets_detail
                 AND pax_header=pax_detail THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dias_paridad,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(ventas_header-ventas_detail)>0.05
                 OR tickets_header<>tickets_detail
                 OR pax_header<>pax_detail THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dias_diferencia,
       CAST(SUM(ventas_header) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas_header_mes,
       CAST(SUM(ventas_detail) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas_detail_mes,
       SUM(tickets_header) tickets_header_mes,
       SUM(tickets_detail) tickets_detail_mes,
       SUM(pax_header) pax_header_mes,
       SUM(pax_detail) pax_detail_mes
FROM x

constraints: Mes completo en una sola ejecucion
